description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate game UI skill icons arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, in this order left to right then top to bottom, each centered in its own cell: a horizontal sword in front of a teal half-dome guard glow; a sword blade crossing a red enemy claw with a white parry spark; an upright sword deflecting two small arrows away to the sides; a sword inside one full circular white slash ring; a steel sword with two bold grey forward chevrons beside it; a calm teal lotus flower with symmetric open petals; one curved teal return arrow wrapped around a gold four-point star; a small green heart resting on a flat still teal mirror disc; a gold-rimmed teal glass dome over a flat still mirror pool. Color theme: bright steel with soft teal and aqua accents only, no splashing water. Chunky pixel art icons in the same style as the reference, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, bold readable silhouettes, every icon fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frames, no borders

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky pixel art UI icons, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, one icon centered per grid cell on magenta. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
